intro.text: The captain of Dalinar Kholin's elite soldiers during the Alethi Unification War.

items.text: Thakka rose to captain Dalinar's elites. After a raid on a highprince's capital, Dalinar was shot by the archer Teleb; Thakka tried to shield him and rode with him to find the shooter, ready to kill Teleb if needed. When Teleb joined the elites, Thakka found his family to ensure his loyalty.
Thakka fought in the battle against Highprince Tanalan at Rathalas. Inside the city he went with Dalinar to a platform over the Rift, which had been rigged to collapse, and was killed in the fall.

personality.text: Fiercely loyal to Dalinar, Thakka is unsentimental about war, untroubled by looting or taking soldiers' families as hostages, and admires skilled warriors.
